original_target.title: Optimal symmetric rendezvous among discrete locations

verification: Literature and theorem-scope review; no independent whole-proof or Lean verification.
scope_comparison: Original exact optimal expected meeting time r_n for every n>=4 over all same-law memoryful strategies, private random labels and time0 first visit. Cembrano–Fischer–Klimm v2 improves Anderson–Weber strategies but explicitly retains the global optimum question; an improved strategy is an upper bound without matching converse. Short-horizon meeting probabilities, asymptotic high-probability thresholds, asymmetric roles and markers do not determine the original expected optimum. Bounded current searches found no full match; not a certification of openness.
